description: 10-year (2016-2025) NEET UG open-source style PYQ & prep bank (Biology, Chemistry, Physics). Expand further via scripts/import_opensource_pyqs.py.

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Which cell organelle is directly responsible for packaging materials to be delivered either to intracellular targets or secreted outside the cell?
questions.explanation: The Golgi apparatus performs the important function of packaging materials, forming glycoproteins and glycolipids, and dispatching them from its trans face.
questions.source: NEET UG 2016 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Biology Ch. 8

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: The dimensional formula of Planck's constant (h) is identical to that of:
questions.explanation: E = hν gives [h] = [E]/[ν] = [ML²T⁻²]/[T⁻¹] = [ML²T⁻¹], which is the same as angular momentum L = mvr ([ML²T⁻¹]).
questions.source: NEET UG 2016 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch. 2

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: In C4 plants, the primary CO2 acceptor in mesophyll cells is:
questions.explanation: In C4 plants (Hatch and Slack pathway), the 3-carbon molecule PEP in mesophyll cells accepts CO2 via PEPcase to form 4-carbon OAA.
questions.source: NEET UG 2017 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Biology Ch. 13

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following pairs constitutes an acidic buffer solution?
questions.explanation: An acidic buffer consists of a weak acid (CH3COOH) and its salt with a strong base (CH3COONa).
questions.source: NEET UG 2017 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Chemistry Ch. 7

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: DNA fragments separated by agarose gel electrophoresis are visualized after staining with ethidium bromide under:
questions.explanation: Ethidium bromide-stained DNA appears as bright orange bands only when exposed to ultraviolet (UV) radiation.
questions.source: NEET UG 2018 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Biology Ch. 11

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: Three resistors of 6 Ω each are connected in parallel. The equivalent resistance of the combination is:
questions.explanation: For n identical resistors R in parallel, Req = R / n = 6 Ω / 3 = 2 Ω.
questions.source: NEET UG 2018 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 3

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Which hormone surge triggers ovulation during the middle of the menstrual cycle (around day 14)?
questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during the mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of the Graafian follicle and release of the ovum.
questions.source: NEET UG 2019 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Biology Ch. 3

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: For a first-order reaction, the half-life (t1/2) is:

options.D: Proportional to square of initial concentration

questions.explanation: For a first-order reaction, t1/2 = 0.693 / k, which depends only on the rate constant k and is independent of initial concentration [R]0.
questions.source: NEET UG 2019 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 4

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Which statement is NOT correct regarding mitochondria?
questions.explanation: Mitochondrial matrix contains 70S ribosomes (not 80S) along with single circular DNA and RNA.
questions.source: NEET UG 2020 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Biology Ch. 8

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: According to VSEPR theory, the correct decreasing order of electron pair repulsion is:
questions.explanation: Lone pairs occupy more angular volume than bond pairs, giving lp-lp > lp-bp > bp-bp.
questions.source: NEET UG 2020 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Chemistry Ch. 4

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: DNA-dependent RNA polymerase catalyses polymerisation in which direction?
questions.explanation: RNA polymerase catalyses polymerisation strictly in the 5' → 3' direction while reading the 3' → 5' template strand.
questions.source: NEET UG 2021 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Biology Ch. 6

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: The escape velocity from the surface of Earth is approximately 11.2 km/s. It depends on:

options.C: Mass and radius of the Earth

questions.explanation: Escape velocity ve = √(2GM/R), which depends on the planet's mass M and radius R, and is independent of the projectile's mass or angle.
questions.source: NEET UG 2021 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch. 8

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Crossing over between non-sister chromatids of homologous chromosomes occurs during which sub-stage of Prophase I?
questions.explanation: Crossing over is an enzyme-mediated process (recombinase) that occurs at recombination nodules during Pachytene of Prophase I.
questions.source: NEET UG 2022 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Biology Ch. 10

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: Which reagent is used in Tollens' test to distinguish aldehydes from ketones?
questions.explanation: Aldehydes reduce ammoniacal AgNO3 (Tollens' reagent) to metallic silver forming a bright silver mirror, whereas ketones generally do not.
questions.source: NEET UG 2022 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 12

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: In a Mendelian dihybrid cross (RrYy × RrYy), the phenotypic ratio obtained in the F2 generation is:
questions.explanation: Independent assortment of two unlinked genes produces the classic 9 : 3 : 3 : 1 F2 phenotypic ratio.
questions.source: NEET UG 2023 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Biology Ch. 5

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: The logic gate whose output is HIGH (1) only when ALL its inputs are HIGH (1) is:
questions.explanation: An AND gate outputs Y = A · B, which is 1 if and only if every input is 1.
questions.source: NEET UG 2023 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 14

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: The maximum volume of air a person can breathe in after a forced expiration is called:
questions.explanation: Vital Capacity (VC = ERV + TV + IRV) is the maximum volume of air a person can breathe in after forced expiration (or breathe out after forced inspiration).
questions.source: NEET UG 2024 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Biology Ch. 17

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: According to Crystal Field Theory, the splitting energy Δt for tetrahedral complexes relates to octahedral Δo as:
questions.explanation: Because tetrahedral complexes have 4 ligands instead of 6 and ligands do not point directly at d-orbitals, Δt = (4/9) Δo.
questions.source: NEET UG 2024 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 9

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Which ecological pyramid is ALWAYS upright in all ecosystems?
questions.explanation: Energy flow is unidirectional and some energy is always lost as heat at each trophic level (10% law), so the pyramid of energy is always upright.
questions.source: NEET UG 2025 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Biology Ch. 14

questions.subject: physics
questions.chapter: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
questions.question: In the photoelectric effect, the maximum kinetic energy of emitted photoelectrons depends on:

options.B: Frequency of incident light and work function of metal

questions.explanation: By Einstein's photoelectric equation, Kmax = hν - φ0, so Kmax depends on incident frequency ν and metal work function φ0, not intensity.
questions.source: NEET UG 2025 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 11
